<h2>About me</h2>
<p>I'm a software developer based in Istanbul, working across mobile (Flutter, Swift) and backend (.NET, Laravel).</p>
<p>What I care about most is how code is structured: clear layers, small testable pieces, and boundaries that make change cheap. I'm currently open to mobile, backend and full-stack roles.</p>
